references.text: The Lord's command through Moses that the Levites should receive cities to live in and pasturelands for their livestock, which is the direct basis for the Levites' claim in Joshua 21:2
Detailed instructions regarding the Levitical cities and their pasturelands that Moses received from the Lord
The law concerning the Levitical cities and their pasturelands, which could not be sold because they were their permanent possession
The assembly at Shiloh where the tabernacle was set up, the same place where the Levites presented their case
The allocation of land in Canaan by the priest Eleazar and Joshua, a similar situation regarding the distribution of territories
The fulfillment of the commandment whereby the Israelites actually gave the Levites cities with pasturelands as the Lord had commanded through Moses
